author: Banco Central do Brasil
title: Registered external debt - SGS 3560
definition_notes: Official BCB annual registered external debt. Series is inactive but historical observations remain available. Registered debt is not automatically identical to total/gross/net debt.

author: José Serra
title: Ciclos e mudanças estruturais na economia brasileira do após-guerra
primary_variables: gross debt; reserves; net debt; current account; interest; debt service; FDI
definition_notes: Table sources: Conjuntura Econômica and Banco Central. Gross debt minus reserves equals reported net debt. Excellent internal consistency for the 1967-1980 window.

author: Luiz Carlos Bresser-Pereira
title: Auge e declínio nos anos setenta
primary_variables: exports; imports; trade balance; services; interest; current account; gross debt; reserves
definition_notes: Table sources: Banco Central and Conjuntura Econômica. Very close to Serra Table 7 but retains balance-of-payments detail. Signs are preserved in the source table.

author: Luiz Carlos Bresser-Pereira
title: Auge e declínio nos anos setenta
primary_variables: debt/GDP; net debt/exports; terms of trade; import coefficients
definition_notes: Debt/GDP is reported directly by the historical source. Useful because nominal debt is in US dollars whereas historical GDP in domestic currency cannot be divided without an exchange-rate conversion.

author: Luiz Carlos Bresser-Pereira
title: Mudanças no padrão de financiamento do investimento no Brasil
primary_variables: broader external debt; debt increase; interest; real resource transfer
definition_notes: Debt concept is broader than the registered/gross series used in the early-1980s tables, producing higher debt levels. Keep as an alternative concept; do not splice mechanically.

author: Jorge Chami Batista
title: A estratégia de ajustamento externo do Segundo Plano Nacional de Desenvolvimento
primary_variables: II PND timing; growth-cum-debt strategy; external adjustment
definition_notes: Historical mechanism source. Defines 1974-1979 II PND as a growth-cum-debt external-adjustment strategy.

author: Eliana Cardoso; Albert Fishlow
title: The Macroeconomics of the Brazilian External Debt
table_or_section: Chapter 4; debt strategy of the 1970s and appendices
primary_variables: net debt; external debt dynamics; foreign borrowing costs
definition_notes: Core conceptual source for the model debt block. Reports net debt growth and discusses borrowing conditions. Do not transcribe unverified appendix rate observations in this script.

author: Fernando de Holanda Barbosa; Manuel Sánchez de la Cal
title: Crescimento econômico e renegociação da dívida externa
primary_variables: Resolution 63; Law 4131; commercial-bank external borrowing; floating-rate transition
definition_notes: Commercial-bank debt composition. Notes fixed-rate loans until 1973 and floating rates thereafter, generally repriced every six months; Resolution 63 and Law 4131.

author: World Bank
title: Macroeconomic crises, policies, and growth in Brazil, 1964-90
table_or_section: Chapter on external borrowing; Appendix interest-cost discussion
primary_variables: external borrowing cost; LIBOR/prime spreads; public-sector share of external debt
definition_notes: Reports that Brazil generally paid spreads of roughly 1-2 percentage points over LIBOR/prime before the 1982 cutoff and discusses an ex-post borrowing-cost measure based on interest payments relative to debt. This is evidence for later construction, not a time series in this script.
